**In one line**: A new Anthropic study reportedly finds that AI models are getting better at helping train and improve other models.

### Key points
- Anthropic researchers reportedly observed performance gains when AI models were used within the training process of other models.
- The work points to models taking over parts of data generation, evaluation, and tuning once handled by people.
- It reads as an example of the "AI building AI" loop, where models contribute to their own improvement cycle.

### Why it matters
If model development becomes partly automated, the pace and cost structure of AI research could shift. At the same time, self-reinforcing loops raise fresh questions around safety and human oversight.
